kjv: and the branch [that] thou (God) madest strong for thyself (KJV 80:15)
mine: and for the son whom you (God) made strong for yourself
note: we'al-ben is "and for the son", anticipating v.18 "the son of man whom you made strong"; ben can denote a shoot of a plant (Gen 49:22), which the KJV chooses to keep the vine image.
